SessionStart.description: Load ONE project context and Xcode build environment
SessionStart.command: echo 'ONE iOS App — SwiftUI/CloudKit/Spotify. Xcode project: ones.xcodeproj. Active skills: swiftui-patterns, swift-actor-persistence, swift-protocol-di-testing, swift-concurrency-6-2, tdd-workflow, security-review, verification-loop, continuous-learning'

PostToolUse.description: Swift file quality gate — check for force unwrap and debug prints
PostToolUse.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const f=process.env.TOOL_FILE||'';if(!f.endsWith('.swift'))process.exit(0);const src=fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):'';const issues=[];if(/[^!]=![^=]/.test(src))issues.push('⚠️  Force unwrap (!) detected — use guard let / if let');if(/print\(/.test(src))issues.push('⚠️  print() detected — use ONELogger instead');if(issues.length){console.log('Swift Quality Gate:\n'+issues.join('\n'))};"

Stop.description: Session state — remind to run verification loop before PR
Stop.command: echo 'Session complete. Run /verify before opening a PR.'
